• **Security Alert**: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, Krebs on Security, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 69 articles published in the last 24 hours
